propositions: Hard-coded version literals in docs/api-stability.md duplicate pyproject.toml and drift out of sync (e.g., 'currently 0.8.0' marker, stale 'SCHEMA_VERSION (currently 3)' when actual is 5).
The test_version_sync.py consistency check becomes unnecessary and should be removed when version markers are eliminated from documentation.
API stability documentation should state policy (0.x SemVer behavior) without naming a current version number, instead directing readers to CHANGELOG and GitHub Releases for live version info.
docs/releasing.md contains dangling v0.8.0-era references to the version marker sync process and test that should be removed, while preserving the separate 1.0-declaration instruction.
Schema version constants in source files (SCHEMA_VERSION, EXPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION) should be referenced by name and location in documentation without hard-coded numeric literals.
